- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/cost_audit.py, `_TELEMETRY_LINE_PREFIX_RE_SRC`: add the optional tab-delimited job/step group before the timestamp group, plus one prefixed test line each for the counted and quoted cases (about 3-6 lines changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
